# Gallivant nonil (doc/gallivant/nonil.md): packages are compiled with
# -nonil, which rejects the predeclared identifier nil, unless their
# module's go.mod says "nonil false".

# cmd/go passes -nonil by default for packages of a main module,
# and not for the standard library.
go build -n -a -o $devnull ./ok
stderr 'compile.* -p main .*-nonil'
! stderr 'compile.* -p fmt .*-nonil'

go build -o $devnull ./ok
go list -m -json
stdout '"NoNil": true'

! go build -o $devnull ./bad
stderr '^(\./)?bad[/\\]main\.go:6:15: use of nil in nonil module \(use Option, Result or a zero value instead\)$'
stderr '^(\./)?bad[/\\]main\.go:9:12: use of nil in nonil module'

# Types without a zero value: pointers and structs of this module that
# contain them.
! go build -o $devnull ./zero
stderr '^(\./)?zero[/\\]main\.go:5:5: variable g declared without a value: \*int has no zero value in a nonil module; give it a value or use an Option$'
stderr '^(\./)?zero[/\\]main\.go:9:7: p is used before it is assigned \(\*int has no zero value in a nonil module\)$'
stderr '^(\./)?zero[/\\]main\.go:10:16: lib.T literal omits field P: \*int has no zero value in a nonil module$'
stderr '^(\./)?zero[/\\]main\.go:12:6: q is used before it is assigned \(lib.T has no zero value in a nonil module \(it contains \*int\)\)$'

# The zeroable constraint admits only types with a zero value, also
# across packages.
go run ./generic
stdout '^0 \[0 0\] \[\] true$'
! go build -o $devnull ./generic/bad
stderr '^(\./)?generic[/\\]bad[/\\]bad\.go:6:16: \*int does not satisfy zeroable \(\*int has no zero value in a nonil module\)$'
stderr '^(\./)?generic[/\\]bad[/\\]bad\.go:11:9: z is used before it is assigned \(T has no zero value in a nonil module\)$'

# Files named on the command line follow the module containing them.
! go build -o $devnull bad/main.go
stderr 'use of nil in nonil module'

# Coverage instrumentation does not introduce nil.
go test -cover ./ok
stdout '^ok\s+example.com/app/ok\s.*coverage:'

# -gcflags=-nonil=false overrides the default.
go build -o $devnull -gcflags=-nonil=false ./bad

# "nonil true" states the default explicitly.
cd explicit
! go build -o $devnull .
stderr 'use of nil in nonil module'
go list -m -json
stdout '"NoNil": true'

# "nonil false" opts out, for code written before nonil.
cd ../legacy
go build -n -a -o $devnull .
! stderr 'compile.* -p main .*-nonil'
go build -o $devnull .
go build -o $devnull lib/lib.go
go list -m -json
! stdout '"NoNil"'

# The legacy module may be a dependency of a nonil module, and a nonil
# module may depend on a legacy one: dependencies are never compiled with
# -nonil.
cd ../usedep
go build -o $devnull .

# Any other value is a go.mod error.
cd ../invalid
! go build .
stderr 'usage: nonil \[true\|false\]'

# Code outside any module is nonil too; it opts out with gcflags.
cd ..
env GO111MODULE=off
! go run nomod.go
stderr 'use of nil in nonil module'
go run -gcflags=-nonil=false nomod.go
stdout '^<nil>$'
env GO111MODULE=on
cd $WORK
! go run nomod.go
stderr 'use of nil in nonil module'
go run -gcflags=-nonil=false nomod.go
stdout '^<nil>$'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/app

go 1.27
-- ok/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"result"
	"strconv"
	"strings"

	"example.com/app/lib"
)

func parse(s string) Result[int] {
	return result.Wrap(strconv.Atoi(s))
}

func main() {
	match parse("12") {
	case Ok(n):
		fmt.Println(n)
	case Err(err):
		fmt.Println(err)
	}
	var n int // zero values are fine if the type has one
	_ = n
	var sb strings.Builder // and for structs of other modules
	sb.WriteString("x")
	var p *int // a pointer has none, but may be assigned later
	if n == 0 {
		p = &n
	} else {
		p = new(int)
	}
	fmt.Println(*p, sb.String(), lib.T{N: 1, P: p})
}
-- ok/main_test.go --
package main

import "testing"

func TestParse(t *testing.T) {
	match parse("x") {
	case Ok(n):
		t.Fatalf("parse(%q) = Ok(%d), want Err", "x", n)
	case Err(_):
	}
}
-- lib/lib.go --
package lib

type T struct {
	N int
	P *int
}
-- zero/main.go --
package main

import "example.com/app/lib"

var g *int

func main() {
	var p *int
	_ = *p
	_ = lib.T{N: 1}
	var q lib.T
	_ = q
}
-- generic/zero/zero.go --
package zero

type Z zeroable

func Zero[T Z]() T {
	var z T
	return z
}

func Make[T zeroable](n int) []T { return make([]T, n) }

func Get[K comparable, V zeroable](m map[K]V, k K) V { return m[k] }
-- generic/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"option"

	"example.com/app/generic/zero"
)

func main() {
	o := zero.Zero[Option[*int]]()
	fmt.Println(zero.Zero[int](), zero.Make[float64](2), zero.Get(map[int][]string{}, 1), option.IsNone(o))
}
-- generic/bad/bad.go --
package bad

import "example.com/app/generic/zero"

func F() {
	_ = zero.Zero[*int]()
}

func G[T any]() T {
	var z T
	return z
}
-- bad/main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	var p *int = nil
	fmt.Println(p)
	var err error
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println(err)
	}
}
-- nomod.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	var p *int = nil
	fmt.Println(p)
}
-- $WORK/nomod.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	var p *int = nil
	fmt.Println(p)
}
-- explicit/go.mod --
module example.com/explicit

go 1.27
nonil true
-- explicit/main.go --
package main

func main() {
	var p *int = nil
	_ = p
}
-- legacy/go.mod --
module example.com/legacy

go 1.27
nonil false
-- legacy/main.go --
package main

import "example.com/legacy/lib"

func main() {
	_ = lib.Find()
	_ = lib.Zero[*int]()
}
-- legacy/lib/lib.go --
package lib

func Find() *int {
	return nil
}

type Config struct {
	Name string
	Log  *int
}

// Outside nonil modules every type satisfies zeroable.
func Zero[T zeroable]() T {
	var z T
	return z
}
-- usedep/go.mod --
module example.com/usedep

go 1.27

require example.com/legacy v0.0.0

replace example.com/legacy => ../legacy
-- usedep/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"option"

	"example.com/legacy/lib"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(option.IsNone(option.FromPtr(lib.Find())))
	var c lib.Config // a struct of another module has a zero value
	fmt.Println(c.Name, lib.Config{Name: "x"}.Name)
}
-- invalid/go.mod --
module example.com/invalid

go 1.27
nonil maybe
-- invalid/main.go --
package main

func main() {}
